name: TUKABEL · Fero · Vykouřený basový řev
description: Native Slovak, slovenčina, clearly articulated Slovak consonants and vowels. Male, late fifties. Persona: furious village tournament organiser in a grotesque animated black comedy. An EXTREME burnt-out, chain-smoked bass-baritone: dense chest resonance, abrasive broken gravel, harsh creaking vocal fry, as if every sentence has to force its way past a sack of stones. Barking commands, sudden incredulous upward lunges, emphatic punchlines and irritated breathy growls between clauses. Very theatrical, explosive, rough and ridiculous, never a polite narrator or a normal conversational man. Low-mid register with violent intonation swings, NOT a whisper. Mild eastern Slovak cadence only; the personality comes from texture and acting. Every word must remain intelligible. Clean close dry recording, no music, ambience or effects.
